summary: This configuration file sets up security permissions and automated hooks for a development environment. It blocks access to sensitive files like environment variables and private keys, then defines three types of automated checks: allowing pytest commands before tool execution, running a Python linter on modified Python files after writes, and executing tests when the session stops.

explanations.3: This denies read access to three categories of files: .env files (which contain secrets), any .key files anywhere in the project (private keys), and anything in a secrets folder.
explanations.8: The matcher "Bash" means this hook applies when a Bash command tool is about to be used.
explanations.12: This extracts the command from the incoming request, checks if it starts with 'pytest', and if so, outputs a permission decision to allow it to run.
explanations.19: The matcher "Write|Edit" means this hook triggers after either a file write or edit operation completes.
explanations.23: This extracts the file path that was modified, checks if it's a Python file (.py), and if so, runs the ruff linter to check for code quality issues.
explanations.30: This hook runs when the session stops, executing pytest in quiet mode to run all tests before shutdown.
